الـ Nested CV: search جوه كل fold

بيدّي كل شغلانة loop لوحدها. الـ loop البرّاني بيقسم الداتا لجزء training وجزء test. وعلى كل جزء training برّاني، الـ grid search كله بيشتغل بالـ folds الجوّانية بتاعته، ويختار إعداد، ويعمل refit على الجزء ده كله. وبعدين الجزء الـ test البرّاني، اللي الـ search عمره ما لمسه، بيقيّم النتيجة. ومتوسط الـ folds البرّانية بيقدّر أداء الطريقة نفسها: "اعمل tuning بالـ grid ده، وبعدين fit". وفي scikit-learn ده سطر واحد: ابعت الـ search object لـ

tabs.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=5200, n_features=20, n_informative=4,
                           flip_y=0.1, random_state=1)
X_dev, y_dev = X[:200], y[:200]  # the labeled rows you have
X_new, y_new = X[200:], y[200:]  # stands in for production traffic
grid = {"max_depth": range(1, 11), "min_samples_leaf": [1, 10]}
inner = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)
search = GridSearchCV(DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0), grid, cv=inner)
search.fit(X_dev, y_dev)  # 20 candidates x 5 folds
print(f"best_score_ {search.best_score_:.3f}")  # goes into the model card
print(f"new data    {search.score(X_new, y_new):.3f}")
# best_score_ 0.790
# new data    0.758

tabs.label: ✅ صح
tabs.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold, cross_validate
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=5200, n_features=20, n_informative=4,
                           flip_y=0.1, random_state=1)
X_dev, y_dev = X[:200], y[:200]
X_new, y_new = X[200:], y[200:]
grid = {"max_depth": range(1, 11), "min_samples_leaf": [1, 10]}
inner = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)
outer = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=1)
search = GridSearchCV(DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0), grid, cv=inner)
nested = cross_validate(search, X_dev, y_dev, cv=outer, return_estimator=True)
print(f"nested CV {nested['test_score'].mean():.3f}")  # the number to report
print([tuple(s.best_params_.values()) for s in nested["estimator"]])
final = search.fit(X_dev, y_dev)  # the model you ship: all 200 rows
print(f"new data  {final.score(X_new, y_new):.3f}")
# nested CV 0.765
# [(2, 1), (2, 10), (2, 1), (2, 10), (2, 1)]
# new data  0.758
